question: can the CLI tell that the editor rewrote a draft after a receipt was issued?

receipt_built_from.path: a fresh `jianying build` of the same plan (pre-editor state)

verified_against.note: this is the real draft the editor opened and saved earlier in the session

result.message: draft content changed since the receipt was issued: recorded 99f58d85c75acdad5316d5dda6a1581236a88288aef83f7f61816b088866187d, observed 880e1e1a0a8a4b8fdb4e8b3d6cc418859ed85100a940b78e3ad59a63268d399b (the editor regenerates draft, material and segment ids whenever it saves)
recovery: re-issue the receipt against the draft as it is now: the editor rewrites ids on every save, so a receipt cannot survive one

why_this_matters: before this change the same situation surfaced as 'official draft resource is missing or ambiguous: resource … matched 0 nodes', which points at the caller's resource id instead of at the editor save that actually invalidated the receipt
not_proven: the receipt used synthetic terms and a synthetic asset id; only the drafts are real
no editor save was triggered during this measurement - the saved draft came from the earlier session
